## Publication Security Gate

I verified that this PR does **not** expose:

- [ ] credentials, passwords, API keys, tokens or recovery secrets
- [ ] real private IP or MAC addresses
- [ ] serial numbers or unique private device identifiers
- [ ] private/internal hostnames or unnecessary network topology details
- [ ] personal household or location information
- [ ] private camera footage or sensitive physical-security information

If any box cannot be checked, explain why **without posting the sensitive value** and do not request merge until it is resolved.
